items.title: Apartment handover (Wohnungsabnahme) inspection
items.quote: Für die Abnahme der Wohnung Am Mühlbach 2, 2. OG rechts, schlagen wir folgenden Termin vor: Samstag, 15.03.2025, 09:30 Uhr, Treffpunkt vor der Wohnungstür.
items.computation: The letter proposes a specific calendar date and time for the handover appointment: Saturday 15.03.2025, 09:30. This is a fixed date as printed, so no period calculation is needed. Note the wording 'schlagen wir vor' (we propose) means this is a suggested date, not yet confirmed as binding by the tenant.

items.title: End of tenancy / lease termination date
items.quote: wir bestätigen den Eingang Ihrer Kündigung vom 20.12.2024 zum 31.03.2025.
items.computation: The landlord confirms receipt of the tenant's notice of termination (sent 20.12.2024) effective as of the fixed calendar date 31.03.2025, i.e. the tenancy ends and the apartment must be vacated/returned by this date. This is a fixed date stated in the letter, no period calculation required.

items.title: Hand over all keys at the inspection appointment
items.quote: Bitte übergeben Sie uns dabei alle Schlüssel (laut Übergabeprotokoll fünf Stück), und lesen Sie die Zählerstände gemeinsam mit uns ab.
items.computation: This task ('dabei' = at the proposed appointment) is tied to the same date as the handover appointment: Saturday 15.03.2025.

warnings: The inspection appointment (15.03.2025) is only proposed ('schlagen wir vor') by the landlord, not confirmed as final — the tenant should check whether this date suits them or needs to be rearranged.
No payment, IBAN transfer or demand for money is requested in this letter; the IBAN shown is only the company's general bank contact detail in the letterhead.
